notes.title: The Regreening is Forged in Germany! With a cozy, soft, wholesome hammer.
notes.content: [h2]Hallo, dear friends! 🌱💚[/h2][p]Today’s a [i]special day[/i] for [b]The Regreening.[/b] Why? Because we're part of our [b]very first Steam event[/b]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/7713979e6fd9cc01ce5a0fd6f56e31038eed4fa7.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re proud and very grateful to join our fellow [b]amazing German studios and initiatives[/b] who are crafting beautiful, weird, innovative, and heartfelt games.[/p][p]To celebrate, we’re super excited to finally reveal what we’ve been growing in our backyards:[/p][list][*][p]🌍 [b]The Regreening Steam Page is now available in whole 11 languages![/b] (Hi, ola, привіт, ahoj, 你好merhaba, and beyond!) We want players from all corners of the world to feel at home in The Regreening.[/p][/*][/list][p]So consider checking it out and wishlisting![b] [/b]Because, you know, wishlisting is free and it helps every game and developer be seen 🌿[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419080/The_Regreening/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/67925e760e9427b301ada6c87324e79b509ba3ef.png"][/img][/p][p]And if you want behind-the-scenes peeks and cozy updates, [url="https://1d5da2d1.sibforms.com/serve/MUIFAHlYm080USFd2UJ33f7nnUCrcaE_qtTPcjzqP7r5y-8rEeqa87RX817RJghb5u6P1KBxETtZXYEX6NUZZ4pOYWHhMryh-a0j9o0u7x4LN76kJNUkfce-LFFH5rQ2UVCoUZL9vw66zAD65vQhcqHeDGCx1Kp93h-Ct9EEL1M5evXn7uHfXmltvKA7wIjWrZ9odm86qoZclP__"]sign up for our newsletter[/url]. There’s room for everyone around our virtual campfire.[/p][p][url="https://bit.ly/TheRegreeningNewsletter"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667437/49b1260ce7609ce6d13e67f2cc00e2728d897ccf.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]Thank you for being here, and let’s regreen the world![/p][p]— Volha & The Regreening Team 💚[/p]
